title: Add a compliance certificate, or enroll the unit, from the work order card
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance; make sure 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM' also holds a compliance service 'CVIP' with a 12-month term. Save.
  3. Enroll unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' on that schedule (no CVIP certificate on file). Make sure unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' is on no schedule.
  4. Create a work order for each unit (New Work Order on the customer page).
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order for 402, expand the Maintenance schedule card and find the way to add a certificate for CVIP (the spec and the design give no wording for it).
  2. Add a certificate: Number C-448210, Start date today, Term 12 months; check End date fills in, then save.
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab and read CVIP's due date.
  4. Open the work order for 403 and read the Maintenance schedule card.
  5. Press the enrol action and read the window that opens; press Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A compliance certificate can be added from the work order card, just as from the asset.
  • After saving, End date is today plus 12 months, and the asset shows CVIP due on that End date.
  • For 403, which is on no schedule, the card offers to enroll it (spec wording Enroll in Schedule; the design shows Not on a maintenance schedule with Enroll in a schedule — write down the wording you see; do not pass or fail on the wording).
  • It opens the same enrolment window as the asset's Maintenance tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S16; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R10: “A compliance certificate will be addable from the panel as well as from the asset”
  • S16-R11: “Where the asset is on no schedule, the panel offers Enroll in Schedule, opening the same modal as S7”
